latest_cos_commentary.headline: Tabit is an Israel-founded, mobile-first restaurant POS platform with a modular product suite (ordering, kitchen, guest, analytics) sold into full-service restaurants, chains, and hotel F&B outlets in the US, Europe, Israel, and Australia.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes directly with Genius on core pos and kitchen_drive_thru functionality; its guest/loyalty and gift card modules also touch loyalty_engagement.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: No dated 2025-2026 product or funding news was found in this pass; visibility is limited to standing vendor marketing content.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Confirm which Tabit modules (POS vs. add-ons like kiosk or gift cards) a prospect is actually running before comparing feature-for-feature, since Tabit's suite is modular.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Leadership names and company scale come from third-party aggregators, not verified directly against Tabit's own materials; do not treat named customers as confirmation of chain-wide deployment.

verification_needed: Confirm current leadership (Nadav Solomon/Barry Shaked) directly via Tabit's own materials, not just third-party aggregators
